task: How fast do refunds have to go out?
answer:
Once we tell a customer a refund is on its way, it must be issued within 3 working days, according to the Refund policy.

- If that date is missed, we apologise first, issue the refund the same day, and add a 10% voucher for the next order.
- Items under $40 receive their refund straight away.
- For other items, the refund is issued once the return is received at the warehouse.

data.title: Courier Y agreement (service terms)
data.heading: Review and exit
data.text: The agreement is reviewed after 60 days. If on-time delivery is below 90% for two weeks in a row, we can end it with 14 days' notice.

data.title: Delivery standard: west region
data.heading: When a parcel is late
data.text: If a parcel misses its 2-day date, give the customer a new date the same day. If it is more than 24 hours late, tell your team lead; if more than 10 parcels at one hub are late, the team lead opens an incident for logistics.

data.text: Once we tell a customer a refund is on its way, it must be issued within 3 working days. If we miss that date, apologise first, issue the refund the same day and add a 10% voucher for the next order.

data.title: Operations meeting notes, 18 Aug
data.heading: Risk raised
data.text: Support asked what happens in sale weeks, because Hub W2 handles only 14 parcels a day. Answer: the backup courier covers peaks for now. Follow-up: review the backup contract in September.

data.title: Refund policy
data.heading: Returns
data.text: Damaged or wrong items can be returned within 30 days. The refund is issued once the return is received at the warehouse, or straight away for items under $40.
